text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Floor-length brown-olive double-breasted trench dress, epaulettes, lapels, self-fabric tie belt, natural front walking slit, brown open-toe heels.。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Edit this exact wardrobe catalog image. Remove all toes and feet inside heels. Preserve all garment design, colors, arrangement and white background. No skin, toes, hands, human body, mannequin or anatomy anywhere. Empty shoes with clearly visible empty interior footbeds; white background through any openings. Hollow garments only. Do not introduce accessories or change clothing.
